references.text: The people wept loudly when they heard the negative report from the spies, just as they wept here at Bokim after the angel's message
Hagar lifted up her voice and wept; the same expression for deep sorrow is used here
Esau lifted up his voice and wept; the same Hebrew expression for loud crying is used
The Israelites wept loudly before the Lord, following the same pattern of collective grief and repentance found in Judges
The people lifted up their voices and wept when they heard about the threat against Jabesh, a similar collective reaction
The commander of the Lord's army appeared to Joshua, parallel to the angel of the Lord speaking to Israel
The angel of the Lord appeared to Moses in the burning bush; the same expression for a divine messenger is used
The people wept when they heard the words of the Law read by Ezra, the same response to God's word
